product_title: Golden Floral Diya Holders with Pink & Yellow Pom-Poms
product_description: Brighten your festive décor with this vibrant pair of handcrafted diya holders, featuring golden floral detailing, pink and yellow pom-poms, and elegant pearl accents. Perfect for Diwali celebrations, pooja décor, festive tables, and traditional home styling.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water and harsh chemicals.
Handle pom-poms and pearl embellishments with care.
Store in a cool, dry place after use.
